queries.query: what is a large language model

result.quote: A large language model (LLM) is an AI model (typically a neural network) trained on a vast amount of text for natural language processing tasks, especially language generation.
At the 2017 NeurIPS conference, Google researchers introduced the transformer architecture in their landmark paper "Attention Is All You Need".
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is an approach that integrates LLMs with document retrieval systems.

queries.query: how much does it cost to train an LLM

result.quote: the training of GPT-2 (i.e. a 1.5-billion-parameter model) in 2019 cost $50,000, while training of the PaLM (i.e. a 540-billion-parameter model) in 2022 cost $8 million
A 2022 paper demonstrated a separate technique called chain-of-thought prompting, which makes the LLM break the question down autonomously.

queries.query: how is a language model's performance measured

result.quote: The canonical measure of the performance of any language model is its perplexity on a given text corpus.
